description: Tableau de bord de développement et d'exploitation : hôte, conteneurs, processus, API, collecte OPC UA, base de données. Nécessite le profil monitoring (./mesctl monitoring on).

panels.title: Temps SQL par seconde (5 requêtes les plus coûteuses)
panels.description: Secondes d'exécution cumulées par seconde. L'identifiant renvoie à la colonne ID du tableau ci-dessous.

panels.title: IO de la base
panels.description: Fichiers temporaires : tris ou jointures qui ne tiennent pas en mémoire (work_mem).

panels.title: Requêtes SQL les plus coûteuses (depuis le démarrage de la base)
panels.description: pg_stat_statements : temps cumulé par requête normalisée. Pour remettre à zéro : SELECT pg_stat_statements_reset();

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.queryid::text AS "ID", left(regexp_replace(s.query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 160) AS "Requête",
       s.calls AS "Appels",
       round(s.mean_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS "Moyenne (ms)",
       round(s.max_exec_time::numeric, 1) AS "Max (ms)",
       round((s.total_exec_time / 1000)::numeric, 1) AS "Total (s)",
       round((100 * s.total_exec_time / sum(s.total_exec_time) OVER ())::numeric, 1) AS "Part (%)",
       s.rows AS "Lignes",
       round((100.0 * s.shared_blks_hit / nullif(s.shared_blks_hit + s.shared_blks_read, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Cache (%)"
FROM public.pg_stat_statements s JOIN pg_database d ON d.oid = s.dbid
WHERE d.datname = 'mes' AND s.query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat_statements%'
ORDER BY s.total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Requêtes en cours d'exécution
panels.description: Requêtes SQL en cours (hors Grafana). Vide quand la base est au repos.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pid AS "PID", usename AS "Utilisateur", coalesce(application_name, '') AS "Application",
       client_addr::text AS "Client", state AS "État",
       coalesce(wait_event_type || ':' || wait_event, '') AS "Attente",
       round(extract(epoch FROM now() - query_start)::numeric, 1) AS "Durée (s)",
       left(regexp_replace(query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 200) AS "Requête"
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE datname = 'mes' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND state <> 'idle' AND usename <> 'mes_reader'
ORDER BY query_start NULLS LAST

SELECT hypertable_schema || '.' || hypertable_name AS "Table",
       hypertable_size(format('%I.%I', hypertable_schema, hypertable_name)::regclass) AS "Taille",
       num_chunks AS "Chunks", compression_enabled AS "Compression"
FROM timescaledb_information.hypertables
UNION ALL
SELECT schemaname || '.' || relname, pg_total_relation_size(relid), NULL, NULL
FROM pg_stat_user_tables
WHERE schemaname IN ('mes', 'catalog') AND pg_total_relation_size(relid) > 1048576
ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15
